metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: Human existence is a temporary, structured performance where people play pre-assigned roles.
acceptable_visual_variants: A classic wooden theater stage with curtains framing a vast, starry sky instead of a backdrop
A stylized path shaped like a stage platform winding through a landscape of clouds
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: An illustrator might draw a literal wooden theater stage with actors, losing the philosophical depth of human life.
metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Depict a surreal, vast landscape blending into a theatrical stage with cosmic elements, showing people walking across it.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: Every individual has a specific role or destiny to play in the world.
acceptable_visual_variants: People in modern clothing holding theatrical masks in their hands
Silhouettes of people cast as shadows on a stage backdrop
metaphor_spans.literal_meaning: Everyone here is a theatrical character/actor
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: Depicting people in literal theatrical costumes might make it look like a specific historical play rather than a universal metaphor.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: The mental space or backdrop where human desires, hopes, and dreams are projected.
acceptable_visual_variants: A sheer, flowing fabric curtain blowing in the wind with constellations shining through it
A soft, misty screen hovering in the air reflecting surreal landscapes
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: Drawing a literal movie screen or heavy theater curtain might look too modern or commercial, losing the ethereal quality of dreams.
metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Show a translucent, shimmering curtain made of stardust or light, with faint, glowing dream-like imagery projected onto it.

translation_loss.what_was_lost: The translation renders 'parde' (curtain) as 'screen', which shifts the theatrical metaphor of a stage curtain to a modern cinematic or digital screen.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: Everyone must participate and fulfill their duties in the grand drama of life.
acceptable_visual_variants: A group of diverse individuals moving in unison along a path of light
Figures interacting with giant, symbolic chess pieces on a stage floor
metaphor_spans.literal_meaning: In this game/play, everyone has to perform/play their part
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: Showing people playing a literal board game or sports game would completely miss the theatrical and existential context of the poem.

The translation renders 'arth' (meaning/purpose) as 'essence', which slightly shifts the philosophical nuance from 'meaning' to 'essence'.

translation_loss.what_was_lost: The translation renders 'parikalpana' (imagination/conception/hypothesis) as 'concept', which loses the poetic and creative nuance of imagination or visualization.

The translation renders 'nayak' (protagonists/leads) as 'heroes', which introduces a modern heroic connotation rather than the theatrical 'lead actors' or 'protagonists' that directly mirrors 'patra' (characters) in L2.

annotation.theme: Life as a theatrical stage where every individual plays a temporary but meaningful role

original_poem:
जीवन एक रंगमंच है,  
हर कोई यहाँ एक पात्र है।  
सपनों के पर्दे पर  
हर दिन नई कहानी है।  

जो आए हैं, वो सब जाएंगे,  
इस खेल में सबको निभाना है।  
कुछ पल हँसते हैं,  
कुछ पल रोते हैं,  
हर रंग में जीवन का  
अर्थ छिपा है।  

हर रोज़ नई परिकल्पना है,  
हर पल एक नया मोड़ है।  
जीवन एक रंगमंच है,  
हम सब यहाँ के नायक हैं।
translated_poem:
Life is a Stage  
Life is a stage,  
Everyone here is a character.  
On the screen of dreams,  
Every day tells a new story.  

Those who come will all depart,  
In this play, everyone must act.  
Some moments are filled with laughter,  
Some moments are filled with tears,  
In every color, the essence of life  
Is hidden.  

Every day brings a new concept,  
Every moment has a new turn.  
Life is a stage,  
We are all the heroes here.
